description: This PHP class 'EncodingMigration' handles database encoding conversions to UTF-8 for the Revive Adserver project. It manages encoding mappings, retrieves language settings, and updates database fields accordingly.

classes.name: EncodingMigration
classes.description: A class for migrating database encodings to UTF-8 in the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: _getEncodingForLanguage
methods.description: Returns the encoding for a given language based on the encoding map.

methods.name: _getEncodingForAgency
methods.description: Returns the encoding for a specific agency ID based on stored data.

methods.name: _setEncodingExtension
methods.description: Determines and sets the available encoding extension (intl, mbstring, iconv, xml).

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Main method to convert database fields from their current encoding to UTF-8.

methods.name: _convertString
methods.description: Converts a string's encoding to UTF-8 using available PHP extensions.

methods.name: getOriginalApplicationVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the original application version from audit records for upgrade purposes.
